contact.heading: Contact details helpers share
contact.body: Pillars and Local legends also see the email or phone number a helper chooses to share on their profile. Only earned Sparks count toward it, so it can’t be bought.
contact.unlocked: You’ve earned {earned}, so you can see them.

planNote: Plus allows at least {plus} new conversations a day and Pro {pro}, whatever your level.

buy.heading: Get more Sparks
buy.description: Bought Sparks count toward your level right away, but not toward seeing the contact details helpers share.
buy.unavailable: Buying Sparks isn’t available here yet.
buy.terms: A one-time payment through Stripe, not a subscription. Wherever others see your Sparks, they also see how many you bought. Sparks can’t be spent, moved or cashed out. If something’s wrong with a purchase, contact support.

whatTheyAre: Sparks are a community score. They don’t buy anything, never change search results, and aren’t part of anyone’s ratings or verification.
